description: This file defines the GrainCancellationTokenSource class in the Orleans namespace, which is an analogue to CancellationTokenSource used for grains. It manages a GrainCancellationToken, providing methods and properties to access cancellation status, trigger cancellation, and dispose resources.

classes.name: GrainCancellationTokenSource
classes.description: A cancellable token source that can be sent between grains, analogous to CancellationTokenSource, managing a GrainCancellationToken.

methods.name: GrainCancellationTokenSource
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new GrainCancellationToken with a unique GUID.

methods.name: Token
methods.description: Property that returns the associated GrainCancellationToken.

methods.name: IsCancellationRequested
methods.description: Property indicating whether cancellation has been requested.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Initiates cancellation by signaling the underlying GrainCancellationToken.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Releases resources used by the GrainCancellationTokenSource.
